Orcasitas — Madrid, Spain

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Orcasitas has repeated, well-documented press coverage of active narcopisos. In November 2024, police dismantled two adjoining ground-floor narcopisos run by two siblings, seizing about 800g of cocaine, firearms, ammunition and over 600,000 euros in cash after months of observed heavy foot traffic. This follows an earlier documented narcopiso case in the same barrio in 2019, indicating a recurring rather than one-off problem. Sources checked: El Espanol, Nov 2024; Telemadrid, Nov 2024; Gacetin Madrid, Nov 2024; Telemadrid, 2019 (earlier case).
